theorems.statement: ∀ (lpush : ∀ (N N' k : ℕ), (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k), (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (Λ' : ℝ) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ X.support, ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ ≤ Λ') → TendstoUniformlyOn Fs F atTop X.support → (∀ j, ∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x)) → Tendsto (fun j => X (ηs j)) atTop (𝓝 (lpush N N' k F X ω))) → ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → lpush N N' k F (X - Y) = lpush N N' k F X - lpush N N' k F Y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
